rationale: No merchant identifier in the raw data maps to a single merchant coordinate (0 of 693 merchants, 0 of 700 merchant+category pairs). The offset between the customer and merchant coordinate is uniform inside a +/-1 degree box around the customer and is independent of merchant identity, so a merchant has no coordinate to look up. Inference reproduces this measured process with a seed derived from the transaction's own field values, which keeps a given transaction deterministic.
